notes.title: Help Schmidt Workshops!
notes.notes:
Hey, did you know you could help Schmidt Workshops by writing reviews, sharing our games, and even by just playing them?

Well you can!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34148628/98b65ceeb831ec968e72d157888052299ef62091.jpg[/img]

That's right, by simply playing a Schmidt Workshops game, you will help to show other players on Steam that these games exist.  Writing a nice review will help to establish that our games are fun to play.  Sharing our games on Social Media, or simply telling your friends about them will help too.  

If you like the experimental, artistic and philosophical themes in Schmidt Workshops games, then please help by spreading the word.

notes.title: Somebody was in the Zone...
notes.notes:
What's your high score in Rocket Blasters?  I think I have been formally bested at my own game ... secretly I've always wanted this.  For my game to find players who would eventually out-manuver my own abilities as its developer ... it's a kind of mark of acheivement, I think.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31268860/f756a567f8084b937540fba094b4435ec0689a2d.jpg[/img]

But if there is one, there must be others.  Who will take on the challenge?  Who will become the next Rocket Blaster?

notes.title: All things are made right, and balance is restored...
Rocket Blasters Update
notes.notes:
The game has been updated.  The destructo beam did not seem to be working, so I was able to resolve that.  However, it made me realize that the destructo beam was not available until a very late stage, because otherwise players would have noticed.  I have moved up the upgrades in general, so you should be able to find more unique upgrades earlier in the game.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31268860/7783bfe77af0c059c8c58d36d59b304041f19857.png[/img]
The Destructo Beam in Action

[h2]
Faster Shooting[/h2]
Also, I sped up the rocket's shooting ability.  Now you can shoot about three times faster (three times more fun?) but be careful, you will still lose points for wasting bullets!

notes.title: Found a Bug
notes.notes:
For some reason the Destructo Beam does not seem to be working.  This is strange, as I know it used to work just fine.  

I will be looking at possible causes as soon as possible.  Stay tuned for an update.

notes.title: Update December 10th 2017
notes.notes:
A few other issues have been addressed.

[h1]WASD Controls[/h1]
[list]
[*]New players will have the option of using WASD or Arrow keys by default
[*]If you have already played the game, you can still assign these keys manually under Options > Controls
[*]Or just hit the "Reset" button on the Controls menu, to revert to the default controls
[/list]

[h1]Overlapping Menu Issue[/h1]
[list]
[*]Hitting Escape while in the Options menu caused the menu to stay there while the game resumed
[*]Escape will now pause or resume the game, and remove any open menus in the process
[*]Escape has also been disabled during the start up screen
[/list]

[h1]Connecting to Steam[/h1]
[list]
[*]When the game starts it tries to connect to Steam
[*]You can skip this by pressing "Enter"
[*]If you do not connect to Steam, you will not get achievements or join the global leaderboards
[/list]

[h1]Taskbar Icon[/h1]
[list]
[*]I updated the game to have a unique icon in your taskbar
[/list]

If you discover any other problems or have suggestions, I am always open to feedback!

notes.title: Update December 8th 2017
notes.notes:
A couple issues were pointed out by a kind curator who reviewed the game.  

[h1]Icon[/h1]
[list]
[*]The game should now have a unique icon when installed.
[*]If you are still getting the default GameMaker icon after the update, try following these steps (if you care) https://neosmart.net/wiki/clear-icons-cache/
[/list]

[h1]Name Entry[/h1]
[list]
[*]The game will now store your name, and does not require that you re-type it after each session.
[*]Also, if you mistype your name, backspace will clear the string and allow you to type it correctly.
[/list]

[h1]Controls[/h1]
[list]
[*]The game allows you to rebind keys for controlling the rocket, shooting  and more.  
[*]I had included this feature in the earlier release, but had failed to test it after adding controller support.  The controller script was causing an error, and did not allow you to rebind keys.
[*]Click Options>Controls to assign new keys to control the game.
[*]The game does have partial controller support, it should allow you to fly and shoot.  But you will need the mouse and keyboard to use the menus.
[/list]
